entities.name: Kadı Bedreddin Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kadı Bedrettin Mosque, in the provincial center of Edirne, Turkey, was built in the early 16th century by Mevlana Bedrettin Mahmut Efendi, who was the kadi of Edirne during the reign of Suleiman the Magnificent. Some sources indicate that the construction took place in the 1530s.
